defs.def: the man that a woman is married to; a married man 丈夫verb

ex.s: After we had twins and became a family of five, my husband and I decided to move from London back to Yorkshire, to be closer to my parents.
ex.t: 在有了双胞胎、成为一个五口之家后，我和丈夫决定从伦敦搬回约克郡，以便离我的父母更近。

ex.s: I experienced this when I started switching to a zero waste lifestyle five years ago, as I was living with my parents, and I continue to experience this with my husband, as he is not completely zero waste like me.
ex.t: 五年前我刚开始转向零废弃生活方式时就有这种体会，那时我和父母同住；现在和丈夫在一起也继续有这种体会，因为他不像我那样完全零废弃。

ex.s: This year, instead of cooking at home for her husband and friends, she celebrated the Chinese New Year with various dishes from local restaurants in Chinatown.
ex.t: 今年，她没有在家为丈夫和朋友做饭，而是用唐人街当地餐馆的各种菜肴来庆祝中国新年。

ex.s: My husband, our children and I have had wonderful camping experiences over the past ten years.
ex.t: 我的丈夫、我们的孩子和我过去十年中有过美好的露营经历。

ex.s: She and her husband have spent the last two years traveling the world, stopping everywhere from Paris to Singapore.
ex.t: 她和丈夫在过去两年里周游世界，足迹从巴黎到新加坡。

ex.s: Most page turners are piano students or up-and-coming concert pianists, although Ms Raspopova has once asked her husband to help her out on stage.
ex.t: 大多数翻谱员是钢琴学生或崭露头角的音乐会钢琴家，尽管拉斯波波娃女士曾经让她丈夫在台上帮忙。

ex.s: “My husband is the worst page turner,” she laughed.
ex.t: "我丈夫是最糟糕的翻谱员，"她笑着说。

ex.s: Why is Ms Raspopova’s husband “the worse page turner”?
ex.t: 为什么拉斯波波娃女士的丈夫是"最糟糕的翻谱员"？

ex.s: My husband and I just spent a week in Paris.
ex.t: 我和丈夫刚在巴黎度过了一周。

ex.s: My husband and I agreed they were the best fruit we had ever eaten.
ex.t: 我和丈夫一致认为这是我们吃过的最好的水果。

ex.s: Husband and wife.
ex.t: 丈夫和妻子。

ex.s: Although Mary loved flowers,   62   she nor her husband was known as a gardener.
ex.t: 尽管玛丽喜欢花，但她和丈夫___62___都不以园丁闻名。

ex.s: I reported the strange surface on the skin of the lizard to my husband and children the next morning.
ex.t: 第二天早上我把蜥蜴皮肤上的异常情况报告给了丈夫和孩子。

ex.s: It was my husband's birthday.
ex.t: 那天是我丈夫的生日。

ex.s: Two hours before my husband came back home from another job interview, my daughter climbed up to grab a glass vase from a high shelf.
ex.t: 在我丈夫又一次面试回家前两小时，我女儿爬上去够高处架子上的一个玻璃花瓶。

ex.s: My husband had banana pudding for his birthday.
ex.t: 我丈夫生日那天吃的是香蕉布丁。

ex.s: Why did the author's husband have banana pudding for his birthday?
ex.t: 为什么作者丈夫生日那天吃的是香蕉布丁？

ex.s: Jennifer received great support from her family as she worked to earn her degree: Her husband worked two jobs to cover the bills, and her 68-year-old mother helped take care of the children at times.
ex.t: 珍妮弗在努力攻读学位的过程中得到了家人的大力支持：她的丈夫打两份工来支付账单她68岁的母亲有时帮忙照看孩子。

ex.s: In India, particularly outside cities, young women are expected to move in with their husband’s family when they get married.
ex.t: 在印度，特别是在城市以外，年轻女性结婚后 expected 要搬进去和丈夫的家人住在一起。

ex.s: If a customer is rude or difficult, just think "Maybe she’s had a row with her husband.
ex.t: 如果顾客粗鲁或难缠，就想想“也许她刚和丈夫吵了一架”。

ex.s: Husband and wife.
ex.t: 丈夫和妻子。

ex.s: Now Irene Astbury works from 9am to 5pm daily at the pet shop in Macclesfield，   62   she opened with her late husband Les.
ex.t: 现在艾琳·阿茨伯里每天上午9点到下午5点在马克尔斯菲尔德的宠物店工作，这家店是她和她已故的丈夫莱斯一起开的。

ex.s: Two hours later， back at my house，I heard a knock on the door． My husband（4）     it while I was on the phone in the dining room． "Does Jennifer live here？" I heard a lady say． In my husband's hand was my wallet， with not a penny（5）     ． She left before I could （6）      make it to the door to offer my thanks．
ex.t: 两小时后，回到家中，我听到敲门声。我丈夫（4）_____应了门，当时我在餐厅打电话。“詹妮弗住这儿吗？”我听到一位女士说。我丈夫手里是我的钱包，一分钱（5）_____都没少。我还没来得及（6）_____走到门口道谢，她就走了。

ex.s: “It’s not that talking to the waiter is better than talking to your husband,” say Dunn.
ex.t: "并不是说和服务员说话比和你丈夫说话更好，"邓恩说。

ex.s: Lindsey’s husband was totally    54    by the unexpected visit.
ex.t: 林赛的丈夫对这次意外拜访完全54。

ex.s: Pahlsson and her husband  62   (search) the kitchen, checking every corner, but turned up nothing.
ex.t: 帕尔松和丈夫   62   （搜索）了厨房，检查每个角落，却一无所获。

ex.s: MrsStanley talked mostly about her dead husband, "Mr Stanley and I went shopping this morning." she'd say.
ex.t: 斯坦利太太大多谈论她已故的丈夫：“斯坦利先生和我今天早上去购物了。”她会这么说。

ex.s: Her husband was gone, but life went on.
ex.t: 他受到了惊吓

ex.s: Jenny 31 Teacher (1 picture) My husband and I avoid all products that come from animals.
ex.t: 珍妮 31岁 教师（1张图片）我丈夫和我避免所有来自动物的产品。

ex.s: If we have children, I want to bring them up just like us, but my husbands says that everyone should be able to make their own lifestyle choices.
ex.t: 如果我们有孩子，我想把他们抚养得和我们一样，但我丈夫说，每个人都应能作出自己的生活方式选择。

ex.s: In Greek mythology,Helen was known as the most beautiful woman in the world, and her abandonment of her Spartan husband Menelaus for Paris of Troy provided the pretext for the Trojan War.
ex.t: 在希腊神话中，海伦被认为是世界上最美丽的女人，她抛弃斯巴达丈夫墨涅拉俄斯而投向特洛伊的帕里斯，为特洛伊战争提供了借口。

ex.s: Finding a good husband should be their final goal!” her brother complained, thinking of the high tuition fees.
ex.t: 找到一个好丈夫应该是他们的最终目标！ ”她哥哥抱怨说，想到高昂的学费。

ex.s: After the wedding, I left the church slowly behind my aunt and her husband.
ex.t: 婚礼结束后，我慢慢地跟在姑姑和她的丈夫身后离开了教堂。

chunks.cn: 大约 她的 死的 丈夫verb
